$comment: Release 0.0.24 baselines plus protected enterprise PostgreSQL evidence; root re-baselined for Phase 9 Task 6 allow-list egress module (0.0.26). Root packed/unpacked baselines corrected at 0.1.1 (plan 013 Task 4) to the published @arnilo/prism@0.1.0 registry artifact sizes (718738 packed / 2505460 unpacked) — the previously recorded 713454/2388118 were measured from an incomplete dist build. Pack bytes/file count are deterministic -> tight tolerance. Startup and network-free benchmark medians are machine-dependent -> generous ceiling/tolerance. Enterprise timing remains opt-in behind PRISM_TEST_POSTGRES_URL and is checked against fixed p95 ceilings by scripts/benchmark.mjs --scenario phase6-postgres.

root.$comment: [2026-08-12] root packed/unpacked/fileCount baselines refreshed at 0.1.7 Task 2 (HEAD 2ebc08e + cache-telemetry module): dist/cache-telemetry.js + dist/cache-telemetry.d.ts + docs/provider-caching.md telemetry section + docs/index.md entry push the tarball past the 5% ceiling (measured 756151/2627877/310 vs prior 718738/2505460/307).

aggregate.$comment: Historical 0.0.22 reference sum across 46 publishable manifests; 0.0.23 has 47 and must be remeasured before changing this non-fast-gated baseline.

startup.$comment: Cold-process `import('./dist/index.js')` wall time. Baseline ~37ms; the ceiling is a non-flaky sanity bound that catches catastrophic startup regression, not a tight per-machine target.

benchmarkMedians.$comment: Network-free scenario medians measured by the pre-0.1.3 per-version runners (0.0.15, 100 iterations; reused unchanged by 0.0.16 — 0.0.16 added no performance-affecting code; both consolidated into scripts/benchmark.mjs in plan 015 Task 1). Throughput regression = measured < baseline*(1-tolerance); latency regression = measured > baseline*(1+tolerance).

phase7Postgres.$comment: Release 0.0.24 protected durable event/effect evidence. Fixture stays fixed: 10 tenants × 10 principals × 1,000 events/owner, 16 producer clients, 16 subscribers, 100 warmups, 1,000 append/page/effect measurements, 10,000 sustained replay events, and 100-row cleanup batches.

phase8LoopsHitl.$comment: Release 0.0.25 network-free durable-loop / HITL / A2UI evidence. Practical pending cap is DEFAULT_MAX_PENDING_DECISIONS (32); hard 128 is a batch-reject ceiling. Snapshot fixture ~250 KiB. Ceilings match Task 0 freeze.

phase9.$comment: Release 0.0.26 network-free Phase 9 evidence (plan 009 Task 7). Enumeration: 100k-file synthetic repo, ≤ 2 git invocations per list, results capped at 10k. Process: 1 GiB produced, 64 MiB retained + spill, 50 KiB chunk pages. LSP: 1000-diagnostic normalization at the hard per-file cap. Forge: 100 pages x 100 check-runs, no duplication. Proxy: 64 MiB download at the default response cap, resident buffering ≤ 2x maxBytes. Ceilings match Task 0 freeze. Renderer: 1,000-op A2UI surface stream as 16 snapshot batches of 64 ops + full tree render through the default catalog (Task 14) Sync-path AG-UI mapper: 4,000 events (text/tool/result/message) through the async pipeline with sync hooks only (Task 15).

enterprisePostgres.$comment: Release 0.0.23 protected PostgreSQL benchmark. Fixed fixture: 10 tenants × 10 principals × 1,000 policy/evaluation rows, 10,000 router keys, 16 pool clients, 100 warmups, 1,000 measured operations, and 100-row explicit cleanup batches. All ceilings are milliseconds and intentionally match Phase 6's 50ms indexed-point and 100ms page/cleanup ceilings.

phase10.$comment: Release 0.0.27 network-free ACP evidence (plan 010 Task 8). fs/terminal/mode/prompt latencies through createPrismAcpAgent + the SDK in-process transport; the client answers fs and terminal methods from memory. Ceilings match the Task 0 freeze p95Targets.

phase11.$comment: Release 0.0.28 network-free enterprise adapter evidence (plan 011 Task 6). OIDC/JWKS verify, OPA decision, MCP OAuth discovery + handshake, OpenAPI tool call, and S3-compatible artifact put/presign against in-process fakes and loopback fixture servers. Ceilings match the Task 0 freeze p95Targets.

docReader.$comment: plan 018 Task 4 (doc-reader) extraction envelope, measured 2026-08-11 on the dev host: 1000-page max-cap PDF fixture (288031 bytes) extracts in ~162ms with ~17MB heap delta via pdf-parse. The ceiling is a non-flaky sanity bound; max-page documents must either complete within it or refuse with the documented size/page error.
